chapterInfo.content:
145
Onyankopɔn kɛseyɛ ne n’adɔeɛ
Dawid ayeyie dwom.
1Mɛma wo so, me Nyankopɔn, ɔhene,
na mɛhyira wo din daa daa.
2Mɛhyira wo daa nyinaa,
na mɛyi wo din ayɛ daa daa.
3AWURADE so, na ɔsɛ ayeyie kɛse,
ne kɛseyɛ mu nni hwehwɛeɛ.
4Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kamfo wo nnwuma kyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ,
na wɔka wo mmaninneɛ.
5Mɛdwene w’animuonyam a ɛhran no kɛseyɛ
ne w’anwanwasɛm no ho.
6Na wɔka wo nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ hu no tumi ho asɛm,
na mɛka w’ade kɛseɛ makyerɛ.
7Wɔworo wo papayɛ bebrebe no nkaeɛ,
na wɔto wo tenenee ho ahurisie dwom.
8 # Eks 34.6 AWURADE yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ,
ne bo kyɛre fu na n’adɔeɛ so.
9 # Rom 11.32 AWURADE yɛ ma nnipa nyinaa,
na ne mmɔborɔhunu wɔ ne nnwuma nyinaa so.
10AWURADE, wo nnwuma nyinaa da wo ase,
na w’ahotefoɔ hyira wo.
11Wɔka w’ahennie animuonyam,
na wɔbɔ wo mmaninyɛ din,
12 # Dwom 145.5 sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa mma ahunu ne mmaninneɛ
ne n’ahennie animuonyam a ɛhran no.
13W’ahennie yɛ daa ahennie,
na wo tumidie fa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu.
14 # Dwom 146.8; Luk 1.52 AWURADE wowa wɔn a wɔhwe aseɛ nyinaa,
na ɔma wɔn a wɔakotoɔ nyinaa so gyina.
15 # Dwom 104.27-28; 136.25 Ani nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan,
na woma wɔn wɔn aduane ne berɛ mu.
16Wobue wo nsam,
na woma ateasefoɔ nyinaa nya deɛ wɔpɛ di mee.
17 # Deut 32.4 AWURADE tene, n’akwan nyinaa mu,
na ɔyɛ adɔeɛ ne nnwuma nyinaa mu.
18AWURADE bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa,
wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nokorɛ mu nyinaa.
19 # Mmb 10.24 Ɔyɛ deɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no no pɛ ma wɔn,
na ɔtie wɔn sufrɛ, na ɔgye wɔn.
20AWURADE hwɛ n’adɔfo nyinaa so,
na abɔnefoɔ nyinaa deɛ, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn.
21M’ano bɛka AWURADE ayeyie,
na ma honam nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron daa daa.

na mɛhyira wo din daa daa.
Mɛhyira wo daa nyinaa,
na mɛyi wo din ayɛ daa daa.
AWURADE so, na ɔsɛ ayeyie kɛse,
ne kɛseyɛ mu nni hwehwɛeɛ.
Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kamfo wo nnwuma kyerɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ,

Mɛdwene w’animuonyam a ɛhran no kɛseyɛ
ne w’anwanwasɛm no ho.
Na wɔka wo nneyɛɛ a ɛyɛ hu no tumi ho asɛm,

AWURADE yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ,

Wɔka w’ahennie animuonyam,

W’ahennie yɛ daa ahennie,

AWURADE wowa wɔn a wɔhwe aseɛ nyinaa,

Ani nyinaa hwɛ wo kwan,

Wobue wo nsam,

AWURADE bɛn wɔn a wɔfrɛ no nyinaa,

Ɔyɛ deɛ wɔn a wɔsuro no no pɛ ma wɔn,

AWURADE hwɛ n’adɔfo nyinaa so,
na abɔnefoɔ nyinaa deɛ, ɔbɛsɛe wɔn.
M’ano bɛka AWURADE ayeyie,
na ma honam nyinaa nhyira ne din kronkron daa daa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
